players.product: antibody discovery and multispecific T-cell engager platform

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K partnership metrics: as of December 31, 2025 AbCellera had started 104 partner-initiated programs with downstream participation, with a mean royalty rate of 3.3%. Between 2015 and 2019 it agreed a mean royalty rate of 2.4% across 37 partner-initiated programs; programs with downstream participation signed between 2020 and 2025 carry a negotiated mean royalty rate of 4.2%, and a quarter of the programs signed in 2020-2025 can achieve royalty rates above 5.0%. The most recent partnership agreements listed are AbbVie Inc. (multi-target, multi-year, oncology, announced January 13, 2025) and Eli Lilly and Company (multi-target, multi-year, immunology, cardiovascular disease and neuroscience, announced July 31, 2024).
quarterly_data.figure: 104 partner-initiated programs; mean royalty rate 3.3%; 2020-2025 mean 4.2% (2015-2019: 2.4% across 37 programs)

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K fiscal 2025 revenue by line (as filed): licensing and royalty revenue was $46.9M (vs $1.0M in 2024, +4372.8%), research fees $27.2M (+3.5% from $26.3M) and milestone payments $1.0M (vs $1.5M); total revenue was $75,128 thousand versus $28,833 thousand in 2024.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 total revenue $75,128 thousand (2024: $28,833 thousand); licensing and royalty $46.9M; research fees $27.2M; milestones $1.0M

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K: in 2025 AbCellera substantially completed its final large platform investments in its clinical manufacturing facility and its corporate headquarters; with these completed it expects a reduction in investing cash outflows, shifting capital allocation from building capabilities to using them as it builds its internal pipeline. Its GMP facility in Vancouver, British Columbia houses its manufacturing and manufacturing support infrastructure.
